result.reason: The added cap is mutual and includes the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor and carve-outs, but it does not precisely implement the playbook. The cap is based on all “amounts paid or payable between the parties” rather than fees paid or payable, and uses the 12 months preceding the event giving rise to the claim rather than the claim itself. More importantly, the payment carve-out applies to amounts owed by either party under Section 5, whereas the playbook excludes only Customer payment obligations and specifies that they are not damages. This unnecessarily broadens the exception and may alter the commercial allocation. The margin comment also characterizes Section 5 amounts as revenue share and as not being damages, neither of which is stated in the operative language. Drafting is generally clear, but these scope and consistency issues prevent compliance.
